title: Packaged preview font manifest v1
description: Manifest at most 64 KiB. Fonts are loaded in faces order into a shipped-only collection; fallbackOrder is applied as escaped CSS family strings on the document root. The loader also enforces unique family aliases and requires each fallbackOrder alias to name a declared face. Paths are canonicalized under the manifest directory; symlink escapes are rejected. Each font is at most 32 MiB, all fonts at most 64 MiB, each license a nonempty UTF-8 file of at most 64 KiB. Every font SHA-256 and registration must succeed; system fallback is never enabled.
